payload.notes:
SecureSH 0.1.17 — reliable HTTPS behind corporate TLS inspection.

- All outbound HTTPS — the self-updater, the no-admin mesh (Tailscale) installer, and the WebView2 Runtime download — now verifies certificates against the operating system's native trust store. On networks that inspect TLS (Zscaler and similar corporate proxies), the proxy's root is already trusted by the OS, so these downloads now succeed WITH full certificate verification instead of failing with "CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED".
- Verification is always on; it is never disabled to work around a proxy.
- The mesh installer now reports a clear reason on failure, distinguishing a certificate-verification problem (TLS inspection / corporate proxy — trust the root in the OS store or ask IT) from the host being unreachable (proxy or firewall blocking the server).
